arguments.body: Hi Luca, your yearly gas safety check at 19 Victoria Park Road is a legal requirement and the current certificate runs out on 16 October. We have emailed and texted but not heard back. Please reply with a few times in the next few days that suit you (mornings, afternoons or evenings), or call us. We will confirm a firm slot in writing, with at least 24 hours' notice, before any engineer comes. We will not enter without your agreement. We will contact you again on Monday 12 October. If you smell gas, leave the property and call 0800 111 999.
